title: Recent
brief: Daryl Ginn's relaunched design-inspiration gallery — a curated collection of the best design on the internet (his bio claims 1M+ monthly pageviews). Useful as a design reference feed for developers who want a steady stream of high-quality interface inspiration. - Warning: the pageview figure is from the maker's bio, not independently verified.
caveat: Useful as a design reference feed for developers who want a steady stream of high-quality interface inspiration. - Warning: the pageview figure is from the maker's bio, not independently verified.
details: Recent is Daryl Ginn's relaunched design-inspiration gallery at recent.design, described as a curation of the best design on the Internet — his bio claims over 1 million monthly pageviews. The site presents a slide-based gallery of standout interface design. Useful as a steady design reference feed for developers and designers looking for high-quality UI inspiration; the pageview figure is self-reported by the maker.
